Born of the brutal BALROG and ferocious FELLBEAST, the NAZGÛL becomes... TWO PARALLEL PEDALS, DISTORTION AND FUZZ, IN ONE WITH CLEAN/BASS VOLUME: •THE FELLBEAST FUZZ MKII. The LOUDEST and most dynamic fuzz I could possibly design using a Baxandall tone stack and notch filter midrange. From sludge to shoegaze, the range of tones is just as staggering as the amount of boosted output. You can absolutely slam the front end of an amp the most brutal fuzz imaginable. •BALROG DISTORTION MKII The molten high gain fire of MOUNT DOOM through a trio of 4558 opamps. The new MKII version brings more available treble and the ability to scoop the mids ( PLENTIFUL mids still on tap) for more modern brutal death/black/hardcore tones. That “throaty” sound so many of us crave. (Don’t worry, it can still get as dark and foggy as the V3, it just has MORE available tones) Capable of sheer brutality into even the cleanest amp it can also deliver excellent “edge of breakup” low gain tones as well. From huge overdrive boost to saturated gain it works perfectly for both tube and solid state amps. •Guilded from the PI π BASS FUZZ: CLEAN BASS control is PARALLEL meaning instead of being a mix between clean and dirty, it's a separate volume for clean which can go above unity into boost. Rather than a standard clean blend, this is clean bass, using both a "low pass" trim pot and trim for the gyrator EQ boost at 55-70hz. (If the one thing about clean blends to add bass to a pedal is they still pass the high cleans when the whole point is to not lose bass, then why not do the thing properly?) (NOTE: to use the NAZGUL for bass or baritone tuned guitars, simply turn up CLEAN BASS volume and flip the toggle below it for a bass boost. For Standard tuned guitars, the CLEAN BASS will be totally out of the mix if turned down) Videos will be available on Instagram @blackhawkamps CONTROL "SYMBOLS" 🔱=gain V=volume T=treble B=bass M=midrange D=depth X=gate C=clean All Blackhawk pedals can be placed anywhere in your signal chain. You never have to worry about buffers or active pickups getting in the way of your tone. All BLACKHAWK pedals and preamps are true bypass and standard “one spot style” 9v, Negative tip, 2.1mm barrel.
